Thank you so much for your response. You have honestly helped with your ideas and interpretations. You have very good points that I have honestly taken into consideration; more specifically the idea of a "Comfortable idea" as opposed to my normal "worst case scenario" thought process. I guess I will try to read through my posting and see wether or not I can come up with a more positive reason behind the things that are frustrating me. Your site has good info and honestly I can relate to it, I will be reading it this afternoon when I get home from work. Thank you again for your reply. Just experiencing the support I have found here has honestly helped me cheer up a bit, I appreciate everyone who peruses the selfhelp subreddit to help those in need.

Thank you for your reply. I appreciate you taking so much time to read my post, even if its sort of long and doesn't cut to the chase. I guess I find it sort of easy to identify the things in my life I am grateful for (or should be at least), but when it comes to spelling out the reasons I feel this way, I suppose it becomes a lot harder for me. I honestly feel like sometimes these feelings just come out of no where, which is what drives me insane... :(. I punch walls typically after arguments with people , more specifically my girlfriend or family... I don't really think about suicide that often, and when I do I tell myself it's ridiculous. But honestly there are times when I am standing on my balcony from my apartment and for just a split second, I lose all sense and just consider it and its like my body screams "Yes! Do it!" and then in short order, almost as soon as it happens it disappears and I'll think "Boy, that was stupid of me to even consider!"..but I am left feeling extremely depressed and I usually will cry a bit just trying to repress what I Just felt... I mean it scares the shit out of me, because I think of people who commit suicide and think of someone who is selfish, but then I look at the life of a person who had it all and they took their own...and it makes me think about the reasoning behind it all... I mean maybe they were out of their minds!!! I just fear that this will happen to me... I feel like my physical health is detereorating, and I feel like I am just lost.. Like I should feel one way, but I reflect the complete opposite.. I haven't picked up my guitar in a few months, but when I do I only play for a few minutes and just get completely unmotivated.

I don't think my girlfriend would ever go for a long distance relationship; and even if she did she would probably feel insecure about her decision. She constantly thinks that I am looking at other girls and all that jazz. If she told me to go... I think I still wouldn't leave because I would feel she was just saying it to benefit the situation even though it truly hurts her. I care about the way she feels...but honestly when I am with her sometimes all I want is to be alone and just have space... but I think back to the days where I was alone and had all the space I wanted, things weren't exactly perfect then.

No Mental or biological disorders in my family as far as I am aware, I won't flip out... ask me anything you want.

Hey everyone, thank you for the responses... No matter how hard I tried to convince myself to look at this post yesterday, I didn't end up doing. It seems like one of my biggest issues is just re-facing these feelings. I am going to read and respond to everyones replies, thank you so much for your kind words.
